info.title: NestLink API
info.description: NestLink 12.0.0-RC1 self-hosted account authentication and signed native P2P permits under /api/v2. API v1 tunnel sync and background Agent compatibility are retained. Remote media requires authenticated encrypted direct P2P; no relay fallback.

get.description: Authenticated deployment discovery. Exposes only the public hbbs trust anchor; no private key or relay endpoint.
Account management session only; active devices owned by this account in the configured realm. Online means a report within 90 seconds, never proof of an established remote session.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key and body return the persisted result. Changed body conflicts. One-session grant uses its session_request_id.

post.description: Original controller requests a new PeerConnection and connection epoch using expected_epoch and Idempotency-Key. display_changed requires display_id selecting a different advertised, ready host display; other reasons omit display_id and retain the current display, which must still exist. The display and epoch change atomically. Host approval requires stopping the old capture/input epoch before accepting the new ticket. The original lease and deadlines are not extended. Network/media recovery is limited to three rebuilds per session independently of display switching. Epochs cannot exceed uint32; normal request rate limits apply. Same key/body replays the persisted request without another epoch change; a changed body conflicts.
